scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a good job identifying the built projects and confirming LrgWindowsAppManifest wasn't among them. The error identification was clear. However, the analysis of build configurations was superficial - it noted all projects used Release|x64 but didn't deeply investigate the configuration aspect of the missing project or explore whether a configuration mismatch contributed to the wrong output path. The root cause analysis was reasonable but incomplete regarding the config angle.
